description: Read the state of an API request by the request id it was given: pending_review, approved_for_build or closed, whether a build was approved, whether a product was published, and what happens next. Requires the status_token returned once by request_api; the id alone is not a credential.

request_id.description: The request id returned by request_api.

status_token.description: The status_token returned once by request_api. Required: the id alone is not a credential.

name: get_api_request_status
title: Read one API request
